reasoning:
I need to edit the subgoal instruction to replace the distance-based motion test with a velocity-and-side test, since only one round has occurred so far with no conflicting edits. I'm locating the exact current text about determining the cube's motion from the last two frames to quote it precisely before making the change.

I'll adjust the parenthetical in the "choose C" rule to match the new test, add "including right after the (N-1)th crossing" to the "choose B" rule, and rephrase the fallback rule accordingly—no memory changes needed, and I'm still rejecting the immediate-press alternative.

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: - Determine the cube's motion from the last two frames shown at this step: compute |cube_x - target_x| at each; if it is decreasing, the cube is moving toward the target; if it is equal (cube stopped at the far end of its swing, same position in both frames), treat it as at the turnaround, which also counts as 'not moving away'; if it is increasing, it is moving away.
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: - Determine the cube's motion with a velocity-and-side test on the last two frames shown at this step, using their timesteps: v = (cube_x at the last frame - cube_x at the previous frame) / (last timestep - previous timestep), in pixels per timestep. Always divide by the time gap; the last pair of frames is often only a few timesteps apart, so never use the raw displacement. Take the cube's side at the last frame (smaller_x if cube_x < target_x, larger_x if cube_x > target_x). The cube is MOVING AWAY if it is on the larger_x side and v > +1, or on the smaller_x side and v < -1. In every other case the cube is NOT moving away: either |v| is at most 1 px per timestep (the cube is stopped or slowing at the turnaround at the far end of its swing, where the press, which takes long, lands as it swings back), or v points back toward the target line from the side the cube is on. If the two frames lie on different sides of the target, the cube has just crossed and is moving away on its new side; the test already says so, since the velocity sign and the new side agree. Do not use |cube_x - target_x| shrinking or growing as the test: it shrinks across a crossing even though the cube is then moving away.

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: - Choose C 'press button to stop the cube' if crossings == N-1 AND the cube is not moving away (moving toward the target, or stationary at the turnaround). No point is needed.
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: - Choose C 'press button to stop the cube' if crossings == N-1 AND the cube is NOT moving away by the test above (heading toward the target, or stopped/slowing at the turnaround with |v| at most 1 px per timestep). No point is needed.

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: and crossings == N-1 while the cube is still moving away from the target.
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: and crossings == N-1 while the cube is MOVING AWAY by the test above, faster than 1 px per timestep (including the step right after the (N-1)th crossing, and while it is still running out toward the far end).

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: choose C immediately if the cube is heading toward the target, otherwise B.
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: choose C immediately if the cube is NOT moving away by the velocity-and-side test above, otherwise B.
